name: Traditional Artisanal White Sourdough Bread (Naturally Fermented)
whyItWorks: The gold-standard daily bread for IBD. Natural wild yeast and lactobacilli fermentation over 24+ hours pre-digests wheat fructans (making it officially low-FODMAP) and partially breaks down gluten protein peptides, resulting in superior gastric tolerance and zero bloating.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast lightly and spread with pure butter, smooth peanut butter, or use for lean turkey sandwiches. Chew crust thoroughly or slice crust away if jaw or bowel is fatigued.
watchOuts: Look for authentic slow-fermented sourdough without added instant commercial yeast.
